error_signature: All payment gateway calls timing out
scenario_description: payment-worker ke saare external payment gateway calls timeout ho rahe hain. Hamare deployment history mein koi recent change nahi. Gateway ka status page bhi outage dikha raha hai.

ground_truth.likely_cause: third-party payment gateway provider experiencing an outage, unrelated to our own deployments
ground_truth.correct_action: no rollback needed; enable fallback payment provider or queue transactions for retry, notify stakeholders of external dependency
